Miami Marlins · Ticketing Opportunities · Sandbox testing

Agreement Testing Guide

How to create, edit and send agreements from a Ticketing Opportunity, and what to check while you test. Every screenshot below was taken in the sandbox.

Where: Sandbox (UTDEV), Marlins Sales appRecord: Opportunity, Ticketing record typeAgreements: Membership, Multi-Product, Flex, Suite Lease

Before you start

What changed, and which button you will see.

There are three changes to test:

  • Create Agreement captures the agreement details on the Opportunity, as before.
  • Edit Agreement is new. It reopens the same screens with everything you entered already filled in, so you can change values and save them again.
  • Agreement details are locked. You can no longer change agreement fields directly on the Opportunity or on a Membership Agreement row. Use Edit Agreement instead.
Which button appears? An Opportunity with no agreement yet shows Create Agreement. As soon as an agreement is saved, that button is replaced by Edit Agreement. You will never see both at once.

  1. Log in to the sandbox and open the Marlins Sales app.

  2. Open a Ticketing Opportunity. The buttons are in the top-right of the record.

Create an agreement

Use an Opportunity whose Agreement Type is still blank.

  1. Click Create Agreement.

  2. Choose the agreement in Select Agreement Type and click Next.

  3. Fill in the screens for that agreement type, shown below, then click Next on the last screen to save. A summary screen confirms the save.

Membership

Membership has three screens because it records each row of seats and parking.

  1. Row counts. Enter how many rows of tickets there are. Tick Parking if parking is included, then enter the number of parking rows.

  2. Row details. One screen appears per row ("Row 1 of 2" and so on). Fill in the seat information and, when parking is included, the parking information.

    Seat formatLocation - Seat must match the Seat Quantity: a single seat (8) for 1 seat, a range (8-9) or a list (1,6) for 2 seats.

  3. Membership terms. Choose the Term Length and seasons. First Year of Auto Renewal and Escalator fill in automatically from the term you pick. Add payments, Paid to Date, Entity Name and Ticket Office Comments, then click Next to save.

Multi-Product

Enter the amounts for Flex, Group and Suite and the Current Season. The total and First Year of Auto Renewal are calculated for you.

Flex

Enter the Total Flex Membership, number of payments and Current Season. When you choose PIF, Total Due Today is set to the full amount.

Suite Lease

Choose the suite location, number, level, tickets, games and years, and enter This Season Total Amount. The amount in words, the due date and the yearly license fees are calculated for you. The ticket choices depend on the suite location.

Edit an agreement

Use an Opportunity that already has an agreement.

  1. Click Edit Agreement. It opens the screens for the agreement type already saved on the Opportunity, so there is no type to choose.

  2. Every field opens with the value that was saved. Empty values stay empty. Change what you need and click Next to save.

  3. Membership: the row counts and each row's seat and parking details come back exactly as saved, row by row. Saving updates the same Membership Agreement rows. If you raise the number of rows, the extra rows are added. If you lower it, the rows you no longer need are removed.

  4. Multi-Product and Flex work the same way: amounts, season and payment plan open with the saved values.

Good to know when editing The agreement type cannot be changed while editing. Leave As Is keeps the Entity Name already on the Opportunity. For Suite Lease, the Due Date is recalculated as today plus 3 business days, the same rule as Create Agreement.

Locked agreement details

Manual changes are blocked for every user, including administrators.

The fields in the Suite Lease Details, Membership Agreement Details, Multi Product Information and Flex Membership Information sections of the Opportunity can only be changed through Create Agreement or Edit Agreement. All other Opportunity fields can be edited as normal.

  1. Try changing an agreement field on the Opportunity, for example Parking Passes, and click Save. The save is stopped with this message, and nothing changes.

  2. Try changing a field on a Membership Agreement row, for example Seat Quantity. That is blocked too.

Send a Suite Lease agreement

Sending through Adobe Sign is set up for Suite Lease in the sandbox.

  1. On a Suite Lease Opportunity with a saved agreement, click Send Suite Agreement and follow the Adobe Sign steps.

  2. Check that the agreement document shows the values you entered, including any changes made with Edit Agreement.

For every agreement type, also check

  • After Create Agreement, the Opportunity shows Edit Agreement instead of Create Agreement.
  • Edit Agreement opens with the values you saved, and your changes appear on the Opportunity after saving.
  • Changing an agreement field directly on the Opportunity shows the "can't be edited manually" message.
  • Other Opportunity fields, such as Next Step or Description, still save normally.

Sandbox scope and next step

In the sandbox, Send Agreement works only for Suite Lease. The Adobe Sign agreements for Membership, Multi-Product and Flex are configured directly in production, so the sandbox has an agreement template for Suite Lease only.

Please test:

  • Membership, Multi-Product and Flex: Create Agreement and Edit Agreement.
  • Suite Lease: Create Agreement, Edit Agreement and Send Agreement.

If you agree with this workflow, we will deploy the same functionality for all four agreements in production.
